summary: Integrate GPU kernels and serving decisions into a bounded inference system with transparent latency, throughput, memory and accuracy tradeoffs.
outcomes: Trace prefill/decode or equivalent phases through kernels and memory.
Evaluate an optimization against accuracy and realistic request distributions.
sequence: Choose a small supported model and define the reference and request workload.
Measure phases, memory and end-to-end latency.
Implement one justified kernel, batching or memory optimization.
Test varying lengths, concurrency and failure cases.
Compare accuracy, latency percentiles, throughput and deployment cost.

visual.question: Which request phase consumes compute, memory and queueing time?
visual.interaction: Inspect recorded request mixes and track cache/batch changes.

practice.task: Deliver a reproducible local inference experiment with a baseline and limits.
practice.success: Quality and correctness are retained under stated tolerances; speedup includes realistic request timing and memory constraints.
